abstract: Immature teratomas represent only the 1% of ovarian teratomas, and they are the third most common primitive germ cell tumor; generally, they are congenital lesions and affect mainly the first 2 decades. We present the case of a 7-year-old child who came at our attention because of an acute low abdominal pain due to the torsion of an ovarian immature grade 1 teratoma on its pedicle. After ultrasound in the emergency department, preoperative evaluation was done by performing a magnetic resonance study, whose findings helped in suggesting the curative approach. The magnetic resonance imaging characteristics of the neoplasm are reviewed and correlated with histopathologic findings. As it was highlighted in our case, magnetic resonance imaging may be part of the diagnostic approach of this rare disease entity also in a small child in emergency.
abstract_ja: 未熟奇形腫は卵巣奇形腫の1%にすぎず、原始胚細胞腫瘍としては3番目に多い。一般に先天性の病変であり、主に最初の20年間に発症する。本報告では、急性の下腹部腹痛で当科を受診した7歳女児を提示する。その症例は卵巣未熟奇形腫(grade 1)が茎で捻転したものであった。救急部での超音波検査の後、術前の評価としてMRI検査を施行し、その所見が治療方針の決定に役立った。本腫瘍のMRI所見を検討し、病理組織学的所見と対比した。本症例で強調されたように、MRIは救急の幼児においても、この希少疾患の診断的アプローチの一部となりうる。
